title: nexus managed policy v1
description: Generated from ManagedPolicyFile in cli/src/core/managed_policy.ts by cli/scripts/gen_policy_schema.mjs. Do not edit by hand. The data of a managed policy file (policy.toml): each TOML table is an object, and `schema_version` is required. The schema describes shape only; Nexus's own validator is stricter (see docs/MANAGED_POLICY.md).

ApprovalPolicy.description: `[approval]`: what the operator may not switch on.

disable_auto.description: Approval mode `auto` is unavailable, whatever asks for it.

disable_full_access.description: Full access is unavailable, whatever asks for it.

require_human.description: Effects that always need a human decision, also under full access.

CommandsPolicy.description: `[commands]`: command prefixes. There is no allow key.

disable_allow_rules.description: The operator's own `allow` command rules are not used.

forbid.description: Command prefixes that are refused, such as "git push".

prompt.description: Command prefixes that always ask, also under full access.

EgressInspectorFloor.description: A floor for the egress inspector.

EgressPolicyTable.description: `[egress]`. A list here is an allowlist: absent means unrestricted, present (even empty) means only these.

allowed_domains.description: The only hosts that may be reached: `example.com`, or `*.example.com` for its subdomains.

secret_destinations.description: The only origins a credential may be sent to, such as `https://api.example.com`.

HumanEffect.description: The effects a policy can require a human decision for.

ManagedPolicyFile.description: A managed policy file as data: the tables of `PolicyDocument` and the required `schema_version`. The published schema is generated from this type.

schema_version.description: The version of this document; required.

McpPolicy.description: `[mcp]`. `allow` is an allowlist: absent means unrestricted, present (even empty) means only these.

allow.description: The only MCP servers that may start: a server name, `command:/absolute/path` or `url:https://origin`.

disable_workspace.description: MCP servers configured by the workspace are not started.

PluginsPolicy.description: `[plugins]`. `allow` is an allowlist: absent means unrestricted, present (even empty) means only these.

allow.description: The only plugin files that may be imported: `sha256:<64 hex digits>` or `file:/absolute/path`.

disable_workspace.description: Plugins from the workspace are not imported.

required.description: Commands run only inside the sandbox.

VerificationFloor.description: A floor for verification-path protection. `off` and `record` are not members: a policy cannot ask for less.

VerificationPolicy.description: `[verification]`: protection of the files that decide whether work is verified.
